profile: activation function: A function, also called a nonlinearity (non-linearity), used in graph neural network layers. It captures nonlinearity. An activation function can be ReLU, defined as max(0,x). In GCN layer mechanics, a nonlinear activation function such as ReLU is applied. The GNN layer architecture includes an Activation/Non-linearity block.
